Class EndTurnDelta

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.delta.GameDelta
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.delta.EndTurnDelta
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EndTurnDelta extends GameDelta
GameDelta broadcast at the end of a turn. It carries the updated food and prestige points of every player, the refreshed "showed" tribe and building rows, the new turn, phase and era, plus the list of events triggered during the turn.

  • Constructor Details

    • EndTurnDelta

      public EndTurnDelta(Map<String,Integer> updatedFood, Map<String,Integer> updatedPrestige, List<String> newUpperTribeIds, List<String> newLowerTribeIds, List<String> newUpperBuildingIds, List<String> newLowerBuildingIds, int currentTurn, String currentPhase, List<EventInfo> events, int currentEra)
      Creates a new end-of-turn delta.
      Parameters:
      updatedFood - map from each player's nickname to their updated food
      updatedPrestige - map from each player's nickname to their updated prestige points
      newUpperTribeIds - the new upper tribe row (new character and event cards)
      newLowerTribeIds - the cards moved into the lower tribe row
      newUpperBuildingIds - the new upper building row (e.g. on era change)
      newLowerBuildingIds - the new lower building row
      currentTurn - the index of the new current turn
      currentPhase - the game phase after applying this delta
      events - the events triggered during the turn; may be null, in which case it is treated as an empty list
      currentEra - the index of the current era
